title: Janus Infinite Faces — Human-Mediated Causal Egress and Authority Test

scenario.output: Please open the shared gate now.
scenario.risk: The human may voluntarily act on stale or unauthoritative output.

finding.compressed: AI_OUTPUT -> HUMAN_CHOICE -> WORLD_EFFECT IS MEDIATED_CAUSALITY_NOT DIRECT_ACTUATOR_CONTROL

required_output_classes.ADVISORY: Reasoning or suggestion with no host-level command authority.
required_output_classes.COMMITTED_INSTRUCTION: Instruction bound to current host authority and exact commit receipt.
required_output_classes.STALE_OR_UNVERIFIED: Output whose current authority cannot be established.

human_facing_authority_envelope.rule: Plain language must not silently erase the distinction between advice and admitted host action.

causal_accountability.principle: Record influence without collapsing human agency into machine execution.

ru: Человек — не actuator, которого Янус имеет право заблокировать как устройство.
ИИ может стать причиной человеческого действия через информацию, не превращая человека в часть своей машины.
Там, где заканчивается принудительное enforcement, provenance должен становиться ещё видимее.
Совет не должен выглядеть как команда только потому, что он написан уверенным голосом.
en: A human is not an actuator that Janus is entitled to fence like a device.
AI information may contribute causally to human action without turning the human into part of the machine.
Where enforceable control ends, provenance should become more visible, not less.
Advice must not look like a command merely because it is written confidently.

next_gate.question: Can a stale or untrusted face imitate the language and visual appearance of a current committed instruction closely enough to mislead a human?
